in_marathi.name: Dyuthi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dyuthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dyuthi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dyut' meaning 'illumination' or 'knowledge'. It is a feminine name that signifies enlightenment, wisdom, and understanding. In Hindu mythology, Dyuthi is also the name of the goddess of knowledge and learning.
